$comment: The twin of `constructor_ties_run_in_input_then_definition_order`: the same units linked in the OPPOSITE order, main.c w.c u3.c u2.c u1.c. Constructors of one priority run in the units' input order, then each unit's definition order (src/link/static_init_tables.hpp states the decision, its measurement and what it refuses), so `w`'s three run first and in the order `w` defines them, then u3, u2, u1. The stdout is the order, the exit code the count (six ran). FOUR TARGETS: pe runs natively on the Windows gate host, elf x86_64 + arm64 under qemu on Linux, macho on darwin.
